go-gitea/gitea.reason: Gitea leadership transitioned project governance to a for-profit entity. The community established Forgejo as a strictly non-profit community-governed continuation under Codeberg e.V.
go-gitea/gitea.compatibility: 100% Drop-in replacement for Gitea data & git hooks.

redis/redis.reason: Redis shifted from permissive BSD-3 to restrictive dual SSPL/RSALv2 licensing. Valkey is the official Linux Foundation open-source drop-in fork backed by AWS, Google, and Oracle.
redis/redis.compatibility: 100% Protocol and command-line compatibility with Redis 7.2.4.

hashicorp/terraform.reason: HashiCorp re-licensed Terraform under the non-open Business Source License (BSL). OpenTofu is the Linux Foundation truly open-source continuation with MPLv2 licensing.
hashicorp/terraform.compatibility: Native HCL and provider compatibility with zero code changes.

mattermost/focalboard.reason: Focalboard standalone repository was archived by Mattermost in 2023. AFFiNE and AppFlowy provide modern, active local-first knowledge boards with active maintainer velocity.
mattermost/focalboard.compatibility: Modern block-based visual workspace and Kanban board.

libreddit/libreddit.reason: The original Libreddit project was abandoned following upstream API lockouts. Redlib is the actively maintained community fork with fresh scrapers and privacy patches.
libreddit/libreddit.compatibility: Zero JavaScript, tracker-free private browser frontend.
